skill.name: writing-plans
skill.description: Create detailed implementation plans before starting multi-step coding tasks.
skill.summary: Plans software work with exact tasks, files, tests, commands, and execution handoff options.
skill.author: Cycleaddict

content.value_statement: Complex implementation work can fail when tasks, files, tests, and handoffs are unclear. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code create detailed plans with small steps, exact paths, tests, and execution options.
actual_capabilities: Creates plan headers with goal, architecture, and tech stack sections.
Breaks implementation work into small steps that take about two to five minutes.
Lists exact files to create, modify, and test for each task.
Adds failing test steps, minimal implementation steps, test commands, and expected results.
Includes commit steps and execution options after the plan is saved.
Uses the docs/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-feature-name.md path convention for saved plans.
limitations: Requires a clear feature spec or requirements before useful planning can start.
Does not inspect a repository unless the assistant reads project files separately.
Example commands and paths must be adapted to the current project.
Creates plans only; it does not implement the tasks by itself.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Feature
use_cases.description: Turn a feature spec into sequenced tasks with files, tests, and commits.

use_cases.title: Prepare Team Handoff
use_cases.description: Create a plan another developer can follow without prior project context.

use_cases.title: Structure AI Coding Work
use_cases.description: Guide an assistant to plan before editing code or dispatching execution sessions.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Feature Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create an implementation plan for my feature spec. Include tasks, files, tests, and expected results.

prompt_templates.title: Plan With Test Focus
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a TDD implementation plan for this requirement. Start each task with a failing test and include the exact test command.

prompt_templates.title: Plan From Existing Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the relevant project files, then create a plan. Include architecture notes, exact edit locations, and commit checkpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Plan For Delegated Execution
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a saved implementation plan for another session to execute. Include task boundaries, review points, risks, and execution options.

output_examples.input: Feature request for a new import workflow.
output_examples.output: A saved plan with a goal, architecture notes, task list, file targets, tests, commands, commits, and execution choices.

output_examples.input: Bug fix request with unclear test coverage.
output_examples.output: A task sequence that starts with failing tests, adds minimal fixes, verifies results, and records commit points.

output_examples.input: Large refactor that needs careful handoff.
output_examples.output: A structured plan with small steps, exact files, review checkpoints, and a clear path for a separate execution session.

best_practices: Provide the feature goal, constraints, and known files before asking for a plan.
Ask the assistant to inspect relevant code before writing detailed task steps.
Review generated commands and paths before executing the plan.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill when the request is a simple one-step edit.
Do not accept vague tasks that omit files, tests, or expected results.
Do not run generated commands without checking that they match the project.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates implementation plans with tasks, files, tests, commands, commits, and execution handoff options.

faq.question: Does it write code directly?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on planning before code changes begin.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it before multi-step software work that needs clear sequencing and test coverage.

faq.question: Does it require an existing repository?
faq.answer: No, but the best plans come from reading the relevant project files first.

faq.question: Can it help with TDD?
faq.answer: Yes. The plan format asks for failing tests, minimal implementation, and passing test checks.
